scope: Independent read-only diagnosis of the single BF15 actual-stage qualification stop. No source, bridge, loader, manifest, ledger, runtime, analyzer, replay, admission, build, or launch mutation was performed.

exception.phase: parent-stage runtime construction after the qualification script entered its held lock, before a stage receipt, group command construction, attempt namespace, child, group replay, or analyzer dispatch

traceback_location.foreign_spec_check: bridge10._module_from_spec rejected the policy spec because its graph context was not the active graph context

findings.title: Legacy runtime import requests a spec outside the active sealed graph context
findings.detail: The actual parent-stage path reaches stage-runtime02's legacy load_and_validate implementation. Its policy import calls importlib.util.module_from_spec, while bridge10's active graph facade accepts only a spec owned by the current GraphImportContext. The resulting foreign graph import spec error occurs before stage completion and before any replacement command or attempt can be dispatched.
findings.required_correction: Add a narrowly scoped, append-only graph/import repair that routes this legacy policy import and all equivalent nested loader sites through the exact graph-owned module/spec context, preserving source path/SHA, module identity, restoration, eager/late loader bindings, and the frozen validator semantics. A global sys.path insertion, permissive foreign-spec acceptance, duplicate canonical import, or fabricated diagnostic context is not sufficient. The successor must have its own exact source/graph bindings, focused positive and near-miss tests, and a new independent stage review before any invocation.

findings.title: One-shot qualification stop is preserved
findings.detail: The durable exit records exit code 1 and empty stdout; no qualification proof, stage receipt, admission, attempt directory, group replay, or analyzer result was emitted. Automatic retry remains false.
findings.required_correction: Keep this failed invocation immutable and require a separately reviewed successor; do not reinterpret it as a partial qualification or silently retry it.

required_successor_properties: Keep the exact BF15 source, plan, contract, manifest, core, continuation-prefix, authorization, and graph identities bound; a repair must be a new append-only candidate.
Make the legacy policy import and all known nested importlib loader sites use the active graph-owned spec/module context, with exact path/SHA routing and restoration on both success and failure.
Reject foreign, ambiguous, missing, changed, or reordered graph specs; do not widen bridge10 validation or use a global sys.path/sys.modules workaround.
Prove the actual create_parent_stage path with harmless positive and near-miss graph/import tests before any new stage invocation.
Preserve the 89-row ledger, zero-attempt state, original clock, resource guards, and automatic_retry false policy.
limitations: This artifact diagnoses the actual stopped process; it does not qualify BF15, authorize another invocation, classify analyzer capability, or approve a launch.
The failure occurred during runtime graph construction under the held qualification lock, but no group replay or analyzer execution was reached.
The repair design and implementation require independent review before any future stage qualification attempt.
